benchmark: historical author B=0.1. Not B_cri. The |J|-max, Fiedler, union, and quarter-pi rounds are not rerun and their verdicts are not edited.
hamiltonian: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + 0.1 sum_i X_i, J iid Normal(0,1), SeedSequence([20261115, N, k])
k_not_used: 0..91 were used in earlier rounds. k=100 and k=101 are the round-1 held-out instances and are not used. 106 and above stay unused.
forbidden: an energy-only union of two packings
a pi/4 or pi/2 shell displacement of an optimized vector
the round-4 L1 grid and random mixer starts for KM
using fidelity or a quantum eigenvector to build the shells

families.KM: original shared-gamma KM, interleaved triples, 3+3L. L=1 seeds are the classical popcount shells. No standard grid.
families.qaoa: independent gamma_l and beta_l, 2L, round-4 standard starts, two repeats

packing: interleaved triples [[a, a+N/3, a+2N/3] for a in 0..N/3). The same partition at every layer and at every N. FK = J@J with zero diagonal, rms-normalized. FM = block means on these triples.
classical_shell: i_star = argmin of the ZZ diagonal hc, smallest index on ties. For each interleaved cavity, pop is the number of 1-bits of i_star. The 4-by-3 weight matrix has rows (3,3,1), (1,-1,-1), (-1,-1,1), (-3,3,-1) for popcounts 0,1,2,3. Least squares, numpy.linalg.lstsq rcond=None, targets 0 on the cavity popcount and 1 on the other three, stacked over cavities. One coefficient vector shared by every cavity. No quantum diagonalization.
km_starts: At L=1, twelve starts. gamma = sign_g * a * pi / s_J with sign_g in {+1,-1} and a in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75}. thetaK = thetaM = 0. The shell row is sign_s times the least-squares vector, sign_s in {+1,-1}. Repeat r=1 adds N(0, 0.05) to the shell entries only, seed [20261292, N, k, L, r, start_index]. At L>1, the round-4 continuation from up to 3 distinct parents (Zhou interpolation, time rescaling of the shared coefficients by (L-1)/L, perturbations N(0,0.1) and N(0,0.3)), then two fresh reseeds: gamma = best gamma at L-1 times (L-1)/L, thetaK = thetaM = 0, shells = sign_s times the least-squares vector on every layer. Repeat r=1 jitters those reseed shells with the same rule. family_index of KM is 0.
architecture: cavity X frame, one gamma, one thetaK, one thetaM, three shell angles per layer, same UcX at every layer.
box: every linear coefficient and each QAOA gamma in [-2pi/s_J, 2pi/s_J]; shells and beta in [-2pi, 2pi]
optimizer: L-BFGS-B, analytic adjoint gradient, true energy, no classical penalty

seeds.note: QAOA uses the round-4 integer prefixes. KM does not use the grid or the random mixer. family_index is the position in family_order. The confirmation indices were not fit under this rule. k=100 and k=101 are not used.

continuation: KM: Zhou interpolation, time-rescaled shared coefficients, perturbations 0.1 and 0.3, and the two classical reseeds. QAOA: Zhou interpolation, append-zero, perturbations, two ramps, and the best append-zero plus N(0,0.05). No third QAOA repeat.
selection: lowest energy inside each family, then the lower of the two repeats. No ground state, eigenvector of H, E0, or fidelity in the shells, the starts, or the selection.
primary_metric: F_sub within 1e-6 of E0, all N, computed after selection on the energy-selected state

confirmation.pass_at_N: wins > losses, and the bootstrap 95 percent interval for the median fidelity difference has lower endpoint > 0
confirmation.overall_partial: N=6 passes and at least one of N=9 or N=12 does not
confirmation.overall_incomplete: any N has fewer than 8 instances with both primary repeats complete

secondary_equal_param.role: reported only, not part of the verdict

job_order: k ascending, within k N=12 then 9 then 6, repeats r=0 then r=1. Within a job, KM then qaoa, depth 1 then 6.
